newsitem.title: ITALY: Police probe Italy pensioner with pigeon penchant.
newsitem.headline: Police probe Italy pensioner with pigeon penchant.

text.p: A Sicilian pensioner with a penchant for fried pigeon, a delicacy in parts of Italy, could face charges of animal abuse after mutilated birds were found in his car, ANSA news agency reported.
Rosario Robilatte, a retired builder, attracted pigeons with dried corn in the main park of the southern Sicilian town of Gela, ANSA said.
It said police found a pair of pigeons with slit throats in his car and he now faces charges of animal abuse.
Sauteed pigeon is considered a delicacy in parts of Italy with its roots in the peasant tradition, though the bird eaten nowadays is usually raised expressly for consumption in homes and restaurants.
